adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Patients must survive from discharge until first rehabilitation attendance to enter the exposed group; assigning that pre-treatment interval to exposure creates immortal time and a spurious survival advantage.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Confounding by indication may coexist but does not explain the guaranteed-survival classification rule; recall, nonresponse and lead-time biases do not match the study structure.
